purpose: Separate root-search method from visit budget for offline teachers. No production file or browser adoption.

development.execution: Three independent matches concurrently, same GPU and separate Workers; fixed visits and no UI timer yields. Timing is under contention, not a speed benchmark.

selection: Highest score; tie order sh32,all,puct. Continue only if >=17/24, paired95% lower>0.5, everyboard>=1/4, no capped/illegal games.

confirmation.gate: paired95% lower>0.5 and everyboard>=3/8, no caps/illegal. Independent of development.

rules: Same model, rootQ0.4 for halving, internalPUCT1.5/FPU1, same pruning/proofs, komi6.5 and initial4 legal moves. PUCT differs in root algorithm and returned visit policy, not only width.
interpretation: A limited frozen-network method study, not a strongest-teacher proof. Next capacity/model studies remain necessary. No speed gate or deployment.
